description: This file provides clustering services for a dataset within an employee efficiency analysis platform. It includes functions to load data, run KMeans clustering, and store results in a database.

classes.name: Dataset
classes.description: Represents a dataset entity, containing at least the stored file path.

classes.name: ClusterResult
classes.description: Represents the clustering result associated with a dataset, storing labels, centers, and number of clusters.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _load_df(dataset: Dataset)
methods.description: Loads a pandas DataFrame from the dataset's stored file path, raising an error if the file does not exist.

methods.name: dict run_kmeans(dataset_id: int, n_clusters: int, db: Session)
methods.description: Performs KMeans clustering on the dataset's numeric features, updates or creates a clustering result in the database, and returns the clustering info.

ctags.name: run_kmeans
ctags.pattern: /^def run_kmeans(dataset_id: int, n_clusters: int, db: Session) -> dict:$/
